epoch_selection: Same per-class minimax FNR/FPR in all three validation domains, then sum of target rates; full-photo grid1 only.
small_region_policy: Existing DACL positives with native polygon area below 1% after 640 resize: crack93, spall105,198class-photo rows; photo miss counts, not precision localization or198necessarilyuniquephotos.
source_selection: Original TRAIN labels/masks/crops, source sampler, photo/pixel/auxiliary weights and initialization fixed; no new data, mining, ranking or relabeling.
strict_target: Every source crack/spalling FNR and FPR strictly below .05; not aggregate wrong-photo fraction or industrial field performance.
source_test_policy: No test inference or test result use unless frozen strict validation target passes. Existing source holdouts are not fresh factory validation.
deployment: Research nomination does not automatically replace facility-validation-v2 or its app profile.
interval_policy: Wilson95 descriptive only; correlated photos and repeated validation selection limit interpretation.
stop: Complete one six-epoch pair; no validation-driven K/gate/recipe retries or extra epochs; no5% guarantee.
label_review_policy: Original TRAIN review preparation only; no expert corrections available, no labels changed. Existing review package may be an older initializer and is distinguished.
